# DMP Meal Plan

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A weekly meal plan sourced from Diabetes Meal Plans (dmpmembers.com), a diabetes recipe and meal-plan subscription service.

## Scope note

Primary weekly meal-planning source; recipes exposed by WordPress Recipe Maker (WPRM) API and imported into Plan to Eat and the PKM Meals app.
